page.title: Pose Information Extraction
page.description: Inspecting reconstructed golf swings as a foundation for pose information extraction.

sections.title: Abstract
paragraphs: This project builds on synchronized 3D golf swing reconstruction to present motion in an interactive, camera-aware viewer. Snapshot highlights and synchronized playback provide a foundation for inspecting pose information.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: A reconstructed swing provides a spatial description of body and club motion. This page brings the reconstructed motion and its source recordings together for visual inspection.

sections.title: Method
paragraphs: The viewer reads the saved 3D reconstruction and uses each recording’s sync.json mapping to select corresponding video frames on one shared timeline.

sections.title: Results
paragraphs: Explore the 3D snapshot highlights above and the synchronized swings below. Switch between face-on, down-the-line, and free views to inspect the reconstructed motion.

sections.title: Discussion
paragraphs: The current view supports qualitative inspection of reconstructed motion. Interpretation depends on the quality of the reconstruction and the alignment of the source recordings.

sections.title: Conclusion
paragraphs: The interactive viewer establishes a consistent foundation for presenting pose information alongside reconstructed golf swings.
